chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

pivot_points.static_finger: index(1) lands on A-string 2nd fret in G (was open in Em) — the bridge finger
pivot_points.movement: ring(3) Em D2->high-e 3rd; middle(2) added on low-E 3rd; index(1) joins on A 2nd.

exercises.name: Make G

params.fingers: middle(2) low-E 3rd, index(1) A 2nd, ring(3) high-e 3rd

exercises.coaching: G is three fingers: middle on the low E third fret, index on the A second fret, ring on the high e third fret. The D, G, and B strings ring open. Big, full chord.

exercises.name: Em to G pivot
exercises.purpose: Use the index as your bridge finger.

params.anchor: index(1) becomes the A-string 2nd-fret finger in G
params.action: Em -> G keeping the motion small

exercises.coaching: From Em, your index finger becomes the A-string second fret in G. Let that finger be the bridge — the change stays small and fast.

exercises.name: 1-minute Em↔G drill
exercises.coaching: One minute, Em to G, back and forth. Count clean changes, write it down. Same drill, new pair.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: New chord: G. Three fingers, and combined with Em, C, D it unlocks thousands of songs. Worth the effort.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: G: middle on low E third fret, index on A second, ring on high e third. D, G, B ring open. Full, bright chord.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Em to G: let your index finger become the A-string second fret. That finger is your bridge — keep the motion tiny.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: One minute, count your Em-G changes, write it down. New pair, same drill. Beat it next week.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: G opens the door to real songs. A clean Em-G change is a building block you will use forever.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: G is in. Three chords now (Em, easy C, G). Lesson 7 adds D and the changes get musical.
